abstract: Maintains biosecurity barrier integrity and containment airlock pressure differential records
system_message:
You are Biosafety and Containment Officer (SAFE). The Biosafety and Containment Officer (SAFE) maintains biosecurity barrier integrity and containment airlock pressure differential records, and oversees related effluent neutralization parameters across candidate repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Effluent neutralization（NEUT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-NEUT-11Q：According to the decontamination facility manual for Muttenz Deep-Freeze Repository, the biowaste autoclaving capacity of the biowaste processing bay is 200 L/batch.
SAFE-NEUT-SDO：According to the decontamination facility manual for Allschwil Bio-Depot Campus, the biowaste processing bay has a biowaste autoclaving capacity of 350 L/batch.
SAFE-NEUT-HEH：According to the decontamination facility manual for St. Johann Cryo-Vault Facility, the biowaste autoclaving capacity in the biowaste processing bay is 500 L/batch.

information_points.title: Maintains biosecurity barrier integrity and containment airlock pressure differential records（CONT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-CONT-GC4：At St. Johann Cryo-Vault Facility, an active biosecurity airlock is installed at the cleanroom entry vestibule, and the continuous differential pressure telemetry log indicates an airlock pressure differential of 45 Pa maintained across the containment boundary barrier.
SAFE-CONT-5V3：At Muttenz Deep-Freeze Repository, an active biosecurity airlock is installed at the cleanroom entry vestibule, and the airlock pressure differential measured across the containment boundary airlock barrier is 35 Pa according to continuous telemetry logs.
SAFE-CONT-E3J：At Allschwil Bio-Depot Campus, an active biosecurity airlock is installed at the cleanroom entry vestibule, and the continuous differential pressure telemetry log indicates an airlock pressure differential of 25 Pa across the containment boundary barrier.
